name: Disable battle animations
description: Attacks, techniques and items skip their animations: an action is its messages and the target's short reaction. The battle's rules and results are unchanged. Entrances, digivolutions and the defeat scene still play.

options.name: Keep the hit reaction
options.description: The target still flinches, dodges or falls (about half a second). Off: no reaction at all, except a knock-out, which still shows the target falling.
